source: USA Baseball Youth Baseball Skills Matrix (https://api.mobilecoach.org/static/asset/pdf/131_e3d62e5a-4ede-41bb-ba90-7a564a9814de_default.pdf) + USA Baseball American Development Model Report (https://api.mobilecoach.org/static/asset/pdf/131_0af48d1c-d21b-45af-9ab9-d32a25b95937_default.pdf)
note: Skills Matrix age bands (Entry-7 / 7-9 / 10-12 / 12-14) are mapped onto LYBS's own division names via data/league-info.json's leagueAges cutoffs, not reprinted verbatim. There is no official published benchmark set specific to Majors-level play (confirmed gap -- Little League's own site has none either); sourceType 'lybs-original' entries are adapted from ADM's Discover/Progress stage guidance and should be reviewed by LYBS's own coaching staff before being treated as settled, not just imported as-is.
